author: DistroTube
description:
Since doing a fresh Linux installation on my office workstation three months ago, I've been doing a little experiment.  I've only installed native Arch packages on this machine.  That's right!  No snaps or flatpaks or any of that sort of thing.  And it's been GREAT!
